title: Warm Malty Argentinian Oats Casserole
description: A malty and tender Argentinian dish featuring rolled oats, perfect for a midnight craving, this casserole is low-carb-friendly and delicious.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the rolled oats, almond milk, malt extract, and coconut oil, stirring until the oats are well coated.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the granulated sweetener, large eggs, vanilla extract, and pinch of salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon or a drizzle of honey if desired.
